notes: Reviewed environment-variable changes for the shared API Lambdas, one section per environment. guarded-{staging,production}-lambda-config.yml inspect reports the state of every listed key against the live configuration; apply is refused unless every listed key still holds its recorded live value (or already holds the intended one). set: keys to write, each with the exact live value (from; null when the key is absent) and the intended value (to). unset: keys to remove, each with the exact live value. Keys the section does not list are carried over untouched; nothing outside Environment.Variables is ever sent. Credential-like keys (SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN, KEY, CREDENTIAL) are refused: those stay in NoEcho template parameters. status pending_inspect means the section has not been filled from an inspect run yet; a filled section is a reviewed plan change. Filling a section never deploys. After a verified apply the section is recorded applied and emptied by a record PR so the next change starts from a fresh inspect.

inspect.notes: Staging holds AWS_MOOV_ONBOARDING_PRODUCTION_ENABLED="false" (template default) and AWS_PROVIDER_SANDBOX_EXECUTION_ENABLED="true". On staging executionAllowed('moov') is false, so onboarding runs against the Moov sandbox and this flag is never consulted (providers/onboarding/flags.mjs onboardingDeployment). The change has no functional effect on staging; it exercises the guarded configuration writer end to end before production and is the staging acceptance for the production change.

Production does not carry the AWS_MOOV_ONBOARDING_PRODUCTION_ENABLED key at all (the live stack predates the template line; the inspect's live variable names list omits it and a read-only GetFunctionConfiguration through the owner's AWS connector on 2026-10-21 confirmed it absent), so from is null. With the key absent, moovOnboardingProductionEnabled() is false and every onboarding function answers production_execution_blocked. Setting it to the string "true" opens onboarding only (Compliance & Docs + bank setup, and the onboarding webhook apply); it never opens money movement. The rebuilt package (run 39588578627) carries @aws-sdk/client-kms and the onboarding modules the flag needs.
